title: Habits file: each commuter's Habitual Travel Patterns (manuscript Sec. 4.3.3)
description: Written by the LLM (llm_stub.py stands in until then) from llm_inputs/habits_input.json, once at the start. Reflections later change only mode_preference_weights (in their own files). $defs/agent is one agent's answer, for one LLM call. llm_tasks.py also checks what a schema cannot: locations from the agent's activity_locations, the activity fitting the location's category, origin and destination at home or a frequent location, purpose = the activity at the destination, unique trip_key, weights for exactly the agent's usable_modes adding up to 1, at least one trip unless no location was offered, and each day's trips going from home back home. See README.md.

made_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (model, prompt version).

origin.description: The agent's home_id or a frequent location_id.

destination.description: The agent's home_id or a frequent location_id.

mode_preference_weights.description: One weight per mode in the agent's usable_modes, adding up to 1.
